summary_rationale: Price-blind fundamental and forensic audit confirms Arista Networks is an elite asset-light compounder: 10-year revenue compounded ~26% annually ($1.13B in FY2016 to $9.01B in FY2025, accelerating +44.3% YoY to $9.40B in 9M 2026), GAAP operating margins doubled from 21.5% to 42.8% (44.9% in Q3 2026), FY2025 CFO-to-Net-Income conversion reached 124.5% ($4.25B FCF, 47.2% FCF margin), SBC is restrained at 4.9% of FY2025 revenue, ROIC stands at 28.89%, and the balance sheet holds $14.36B in cash and marketable securities with zero debt. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unconditional PASS because two hyperscalers account for 42% of FY2025 sales (Microsoft 26%, Meta 16%), non-cancellable purchase commitments surged to $11.4B alongside $3.21B of inventory in Q3 2026, and NVIDIA Spectrum-X captured #1 data center Ethernet share in Q1 2026.
